source.stem:
A helicopter takes off from the ground and rises vertically. It then hovers at a constant height above the ground.
Which sequence of energy changes takes place during the gain in height?

mx.teacher_note: Every mirror forms an upright image of the same size as the object.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The image is smaller than the object.

intelligence.enrichment: A plane mirror forms an image that appears behind the mirror, is the same size as the object, is not upside down, and cannot be obtained on a screen. Reflection from a plane mirror makes an image appear in the mirror; that image keeps the object's size and uprightness but is not a screen image. The learner correctly applies this rule: A plane mirror forms an image that appears behind the mirror, is the same size as the object, is not upside down, and cannot be obtained on a screen. A mirror image is a picture on the mirror surface that can be caught on paper.
